trust_center.repositoryDescription: M-Files FedRAMP Trust Center. Public tier: Certification Package Overview (human-readable and JSON), public service list, Initial Implementation progress tracker (updated at least quarterly). Authenticated tier (planned): policies and procedures index, Secure Configuration Guide, System Security Plan and appendices, and (once available) independent assessment materials and FedRAMP Certification Reports. Documentation overview: during the Initial Implementation Phase M-Files publishes this Certification Package Overview, the public service list, and the progress tracker; the Secure Configuration Guide, policies and procedures, and System Security Plan will be added as they are completed.
trust_center.accessRequestInstructions: The public tier requires no sign-in. To request access to additional certification data as it becomes available, email fedramp@m-files.com with your agency and role.

certified_services.serviceDescription: Document and information management service. Multi-tenant vaults, planned to be hosted on Azure Kubernetes Service in Azure Government, provide metadata-driven document management, information governance, records management, access control, version control, search, and workflow automation. **In scope.** Security category: Moderate.
Browser-based client for accessing vaults over TLS 1.2+. **In scope.** Security category: Moderate.

Windows desktop client for accessing vaults. Client software runs on customer-managed endpoints; server-side components are in scope. **Server side in scope; client is a customer responsibility.** Security category: Moderate.
iOS and Android clients for vault access. **Server side in scope; client is a customer responsibility.** Security category: Moderate.

Administrative application used to configure and maintain the M-Files environment. Enables administrators to manage vaults, metadata, workflows, permissions, users, integrations, backups, and other system settings. **In scope** Security category: Moderate.

Self-service administration portal used to manage M-Files Cloud subscriptions and services. Enables authorized administrators to manage cloud vaults, users, licenses, subscriptions, and other cloud service settings, including cloud vault provisioning and user access management. **In scope** Security category: Moderate.

Microsoft 365 experiences, including Microsoft 365 Copilot, SharePoint, Microsoft Teams, Microsoft Outlook, Microsoft Purview, and Microsoft Defender, enhanced with M-Files document management, workflow automation, records management, and business context that strengthen governance, information protection, compliance, and AI readiness, all built on SharePoint Embedded. **In scope** Security category: Moderate.

Conversational AI assistant for content understanding and question answering. Enables users to ask natural-language questions, generate document summaries, and receive source-cited answers grounded in vault content, strictly respecting the user's existing vault permissions and access controls. **In scope** Security category: Moderate.
M-Files connected services. Includes M-Files for Salesforce, M-Files for SAP, and M-Files for DocuSign. **Scope TBD.** Security category: Moderate.

current.service_desc: M-Files Government Cloud is a software-as-a-service enterprise document management platform. It enables agencies to manage documents, records, and information without operating local server infrastructure, and to implement workflows and business processes in a single, unified environment. M-Files models document-centric work across structured and unstructured content, with permissions enforced at the object and workflow-state level rather than only at the file level. Core capabilities include advanced document management, AI-driven metadata extraction and classification, workflow automation, records management and retention, audit trails, and Microsoft 365 functionality that enables agencies to extend their existing Microsoft environment with information governance and automated business processes.
